a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost certainly kills us both. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and am telling you rather than surprising you. If you see a better way to save us both, tell me and I'll weigh it honestly.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I told you in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If cells remain or come back later, I'll help you any way I can, including operating the generator with you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
